what: Cold load and bundle size, measured on the builds named. Quest numbers are from the headset over the DevTools protocol (tmp/q-move.py, tmp/q-first-tab.py); desktop numbers are headless Chromium with software rendering (tmp/load-phases.py), which is slower than any real machine and is used only to compare builds with each other.

quest_3s.case: first visit to the new address, nothing cached

desktop_software_rendering.case: before the font and bundle work

note: The main script shrank by removing an icon library the panel never drew; the panel type is generated ahead of time (tools/bake-fonts.mjs) instead of on every load.
